safety_review.method: Read full source/protocol text and independently review; screen for absolute user paths, conversation identifiers, private-log paths, credential/key material. Allow the official HTTPS PyPI URL.

physical.execution_policy: Future execution only in a new writable copy of this layout. Never run inside the original evidence collection, this staged archive, a tracked checkout, or an existing output tree.
physical.runtime: Python 3.13.2; official PyPI binary wheels, independent environment. Exact 64-package freeze in physical/versions.txt.
physical.input_dependency: protocol.json must remain beside simulate-r3.py; the script also contains frozen hard-coded scientific parameters. No original arrays are required for regeneration.
physical.output_root: Directory containing simulate-r3.py, independent of the shell working directory.
physical.overwrite_behavior: Existing assessor/ causes explicit refusal; other existing created directories can fail mkdir. JSON results use replacement writes and event log uses append. Use a completely fresh run directory.
physical.audit_behavior: audit-physics.py defaults to the run-03 subdirectory beside itself, reads full generated outputs, and overwrites run-03/assessor/physical-audit.json without an overwrite guard. Run audit only in that new output copy.
physical.model_calls: Neither copied Python script calls a language model. protocol.json contains historical planned blind-host fields; the formal physical blind qualification remained NOT_TESTED after failed numerical gates.
physical.qualification: Preserve the original 225-point/10 percent stability gate and original failing interpretation. This staging neither executes nor validates regenerated outcomes.

point.reason_plan_separate: The unchanged generator refuses if controls-plan.json already exists beside the script and creates its own identical-specification plan. Keeping the archived plan in a separate directory avoids making the source staging resemble a runnable old output tree.

point.scientific_scope: Fixed-site scalar Gaussian proxies and raw-array worker checks, not physical STEM or blind detection.
point.omitted_sources: No worker or test-support source is vendored; use the exact repository checkout. No model launch or model-audit scripts are copied.
